interface_debt.why: This freezes memory addresses in public command/telemetry fields to 32 bits. On 64-bit platforms addresses are already truncated, and any future cFE change to a wider address representation changes message size, alignment, and ground-system compatibility for every dependent app.
interface_debt.better: Use a versioned address representation or an explicit 64-bit address field behind a compatibility layer instead of a bare uint32 in the public ABI.
interface_debt.title: cFE:fsw/cfe-core/src/inc/cfe_es_extern_typedefs.h: CFE_ES_MemAddress_t — a type fixes its representation (union for aliasing, fixed-size array, bitfield)

interface_debt.why: This public macro hard-codes a 32-bit mask and an OSAL cpuaddr conversion. Users must change every use if cFE changes the address width or platform address representation, and the macro silently discards high address bits today.
interface_debt.better: Provide a type-safe conversion function or accessor whose mask and width are derived from the target type, not a fixed 0xFFFFFFFF literal.

interface_debt.why: This freezes memory sizes and offsets in commands and telemetry to 32 bits. Moving to 64-bit memory objects changes message layout and breaks existing control systems plus every app that embeds this field.
interface_debt.better: Keep the existing 32-bit offset as a stable ABI field and introduce a versioned 64-bit offset type for new message formats.
interface_debt.title: cFE:fsw/cfe-core/src/inc/cfe_es_extern_typedefs.h: CFE_ES_MemOffset_t — a type fixes its representation (union for aliasing, fixed-size array, bitfield)

interface_debt.better: Define each public ID as a fixed-width stable type or a versioned opaque handle with accessors, rather than an alias to a mutable internal base type.

interface_debt.title: cFE:fsw/cfe-core/src/inc/cfe_es_extern_typedefs.h: CFE_ES_TaskPriority_Atom_t — a type fixes its representation (union for aliasing, fixed-size array, bitfield)

interface_debt.better: Keep the file header opaque or provide accessors and versioned encode/decode functions instead of exposing mutable struct fields as the public contract.
